The '''27th Elite Recon''' was a unit in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==History==
[[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] in the 27th Elite Recon had use of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], typically painted in forest camouflage patterns, though [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] in the unit still wore the standard white scout [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

When compared to the [[39th Recon]], the speeder bike detachments were more accurate in combat. Their AT-ST units were known to be less accurate but used more powerful weapons.
